messages:
Samira Patel: FYI prospect (ZenCo) wants to start a 2-week POC but insists on: signed DPA + SCCs, completed SIG/CAIQ, and a documented DSAR/deletion proof process before any live data. Can we confirm scope and timelines? cc @Maria Gonzalez
Alex Kim: Ill take SIG/CAIQ infra and data control Qs. Short answers: hosted API = 30d logs by default; embeddings not persisted in hosted POC if we set persist_embeddings=false; Dedicated/Private can persist to customer storage. Will produce succinct answers + evidence screenshots.
Maria Gonzalez: Legal will share our standard DPA + 2021 SCCs addendum. ZenCo asked for explicit language on "derivatives". Proposed clause we prefer: "We will delete Customer Data and any outputs derived solely from Customer Data upon Customer request during and after the POC." Please flag if ops can't comply.
Jonathan Park: Security can assemble CAIQ + artifacts (network diagram, control owner list, MFA screenshots). For DSARs: we provide an auditable deletion flow: request intake, verification, deletion API call, and a tamper-evident audit hash entry. Ill draft the runbook. ETA CAIQ bundle: 48 hours.
SecBot: Control-docs export job created (ticket INFR-982). Estimated completion 36-48h.
Emily Chen: POC commercial suggestion: 2-week free credits, POC success criteria page, and auto-delete at POC end unless customer explicitly requests retention. Also include allowed data types to avoid scope creep.
Samira Patel: Plan: Alex updates SIG answers and confirms embedding policy for hosted POC; Maria sends DPA + SCCs to ZenCo legal; Jonathan builds CAIQ/evidence + deletion runbook; Emily & I craft the POC terms and checklist. Any immediate blockers?
Alex Kim: No blockers. Confirming we can run hosted POC with persist_embeddings=false and zero long-term retention for artifacts. If ZenCo needs debug logs, we can provide temporary, timebound sharing under an NDA. Will paste SIG snippets by EOD. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Sending DPA + SCC package to their counsel now. If they redline the derivatives clause broadly, escalate to legal-review.
Jonathan Park: Drafted DSAR deletion runbook outline and will attach a sample audit hash file in CAIQ evidence bundle. That should satisfy vendor risk reviewers who want proof-of-deletion during POC.
Samira Patel: Great. I'll reply to ZenCo with timelines (CAIQ+evidence 48h, DPA sent today, SIG answers EOD) and ask them to upload their SIG file here.
